title: 28 Dalton Drive | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Large Private Pool with Nearby Beach Access- 28 Dalton Drive
description_expanded: Description: Sea La Vie in Seagrove by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 28 Dalton Drive, Santa Rosa Beach, FL Details: Experience the best of coastal living at 28 Dalton Drive, a newer home south of 30A, where timeless style meets modern comfort. Just 850 feet from the Eastern Lake Beach Access, this beautifully designed retreat features four bedrooms and four-and-a-half baths, each with its own private ensuite. With two master suites—one upstairs and one down—plus an oversized guest room and a spacious bunk room that sleeps four, this home offers the perfect layout for families and groups alike. After a day at the beach, relax and refresh in the sparkling private heated pool or unwind in one of the many inviting outdoor spaces designed for lounging and entertaining. Inside, you’ll find elegant finishes, open living areas, and dining accommodations for everyone, including seating for eight at the main table and six at the kitchen island. Convenience and fun are built in with a 6-seater LSV (Low Speed Vehicle) for easy beach access, four adult bikes, beach towel service, and ample parking for four vehicles. Every detail has been thoughtfully curated to make your stay effortless, relaxing, and unforgettable. Discover a new level of comfort and style on 30A—where luxury, location, and laid-back beach living come together perfectly. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: 0.1 Miles From Eastern Lake Access (3 Minute Walk); 0.3 Miles From Ramsgate Access (7 Minute Walk, 2 Minute Bike Ride) -*Private Heated Pool: 10’ x 20’ -LSV (Low Speed Vehicle) Included (6-Seater) -Parking Spaces: 4 -Dining Accommodations: 8 at Dining Area, 6 at Kitchen Island -Abundance of outdoor space and seating -4 Adult Bikes -Beach Towel Service *Pool Heat is available for an additional $270 (pre-tax) plus a $30 on/off fee. *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 10 4 Bedrooms / 4 Full Baths / 1 Half Bath First Floor: -Guest Room 1: King Bed with Private Bath -Kitchen / Living / Dining / Half Bath / Pool Lanai Second Floor: -Guest Room 2: King Bed with Private Bath -Guest Room 3: King Bed with Private Bath -Guest Room 4: Bunk Room with Two Built In Bunk Beds (Twin/Twin), Private Bath -Laundry Room Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
